facts.quote: As our business continues to grow and evolve, so will our Direct Trade model to continue our mission of making the most positive impact where we can.
We do this by honoring our Direct Trade relationships, paying quality premiums for our coffees, and creating multi-year commitments to our producers.
Additionally, the campaign encouraged visits to Stumptown cafes, showcasing their unique brand experience and deepening customer engagement.

parsed.subject: Collaboration Opportunity for a Stumptown Coffee Roasters Instagram Post
parsed.body:
Hi Stumptown Coffee Roasters team,

We’re reaching out to propose a collaborative Instagram post that builds on your recent mission to honor your Direct Trade relationships, pay quality premiums for your coffees, and create multi-year commitments to your producers. You’ve highlighted the importance of these values, and we believe a visual post that showcases your dedication to these commitments would resonate with your audience and further deepen their engagement with your brand. This post would feature a curated selection of your favorite coffee blends, paired with a visually appealing quote or statement that reflects your commitment to quality and partnership. It would be a chance to further reinforce your mission and showcase your dedication to the Direct Trade model in a way that feels authentic and engaging for your followers.

Reply if you’re interested in exploring this further.

The BrandPilot team
